title: complete_task
description: Mark a task as completed for the authenticated user. This tool should be used when the user indicates they've finished, completed, or done a task. Natural language examples: 'Mark the grocery task as done', 'I finished buying milk', 'Complete my dentist task'. NOTE: If task_id is not provided, the agent should first use list_tasks to find the matching task.

user_id.description: The authenticated user's ID (extracted from JWT token). Required for user data isolation.

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task to complete. If not provided by user, agent should use list_tasks to find matching task by title/description.

success.description: Whether the task was marked as completed successfully

task.description: The updated task object with completed=true

message.description: User-friendly confirmation message (e.g., 'Completed task: Buy groceries')

errors.description: Task with given ID does not exist or does not belong to user
User ID mismatch or invalid JWT token
Failed to update task in database

implementation.reuse: 100% - Phase II function unchanged (wrapper ensures completed=true)

agent_notes: If user references a task by title/description (e.g., 'complete the grocery task'), chain list_tasks first to find the task_id
If multiple tasks match, ask user to clarify which one
If no tasks match, inform user and offer to create a new task instead
